    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_004]
    gpu_hours_est: 8

    claim: ["Claim 2"]
    description: "Cross-task check on Qwen. With IFR, Jaccard should be lower → CSS may recover"
    priority: P1
    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_006]
    gpu_hours_est: 8

  - plan_id: plan_008
    name: "Gemma-2 2B IOI K=3"
    claim: ["Claim 1"]
    description: "Scale to 2B model"
    priority: P2
    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_006]
    gpu_hours_est: 16

    name: "Llama-3.1 8B IOI K=3"
    claim: ["Claim 1"]
    description: "Scale to 8B model. Needs A100 80GB for EP"
    priority: P3
    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_008]
    gpu_hours_est: 24

    name: "Binarization sensitivity ablation"
    claim: ["Claim 3"]
    description: "Systematic k sweep on all models/tasks, show CSS stable across k=50-150"
    priority: P1
    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_006]
    gpu_hours_est: 4

    name: "Ablation method comparison (zero vs mean vs resample)"
    claim: ["Claim 1"]
    description: "Compare ablation methods on all tasks, show CSS advantage is robust to evaluation choice"
    priority: P2
    status: planned
    depends_on: [plan_004]
    gpu_hours_est: 8

  - plan_id: plan_012
    name: "CIRCUS as negative ablation"
    claim: ["Claim 4"]
    description: "D021: CIRCUS failed 3x. Use as negative ablation showing structural consensus > faithfulness scoring"
    registry_id: null
    priority: P2
    status: planned
    depends_on: []
    gpu_hours_est: 0

    priority: P1
